sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully targets ships, checks the ice-strengthened applicability status through the supplied ship-to-hull-structure path, preserves the declared ship-owned operands and result, uses the canonical vocabulary with compatible quantity units, and enforces steelRenewalRequired as true exactly when gaugedThickness is less than netThickness plus 0.0005 m. No semantic repair or vocabulary matching is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the candidate applies the renewal rule to every ship and omits the verified applicability condition that the structure is ice strengthened.
